people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

translations.web: So they took up Jonah, and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
translations.bsb: Then they picked up Jonah and cast him into the sea, and the raging sea grew calm.
translations.kjv: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
translations.asv: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea; and the sea ceased from its raging.
